question: Map the chain from a Wireless Communication market requirement to a measurable parameter and then to a required capability of Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer.
answer: The Vault has no single page that maps a generic Wireless Communication requirement to a parameter and then to an instrument capability. The best documented example of that chain is satellite (NTN) testing. Requirement: NTN breaks the old assumption that only the UE moves and the network stays fixed. Test conditions must still be reproducible, accurate and comparable. Measurable parameters: the test setup has to reproduce high path loss, Doppler shift, time delay, delay variance and atmospheric effects. For satellite access node (SAN) conformance under TS 38.108/38.181, the measured items include output power, frequency error, modulation quality, ACLR and receiver sensitivity. Signal generator capability: the R&S SMW200A fading emulator supports TDL/CDL, Doppler, delay and path loss. With B14/B15 plus SMW-K820 (firmware ≥ 5.30) it emulates up to 1073 ms delay and up to ±1 MHz Doppler, and for component testing it reaches up to 67 GHz. Signal analyzer capability: the R&S FSW offers up to 85 GHz with up to 8 GHz analysis bandwidth, plus EVM, ACLR and group delay analysis. These numbers come from a 2025 presentation summary and should be checked against the official spec sheets.
missing: No Vault page states an explicit general 'market requirement → measurable parameter → SG/SA capability' traceability for Wireless Communication; the chain is put together from NTN pages. The SG/SA figures come from a 2025 presentation summary, not official datasheets, and no threshold limits (for example EVM or ACLR pass values) are given.

key_points.point: Market requirement: in NTN both the UE and the network entities move, but test conditions must stay reproducible, accurate and comparable
key_points.quote: NTN 需考慮 UE 與 network entities 兩者 mobility

key_points.point: Measurable channel parameters the test setup must reproduce: path loss, Doppler shift, time delay, delay variance
key_points.quote: setup 需加入 high path loss、Doppler shift、time delay、delay variance

key_points.point: Measured SAN conformance items include output power, frequency error, modulation quality and ACLR
key_points.quote: 測試重點包含 output power、power dynamics、frequency error、modulation quality、ACLR

key_points.point: Signal generator capability: the SMW200A fading emulator covers TDL/CDL, Doppler, delay and path loss
key_points.quote: [[R&S SMW200A]] 可配備 fading emulator，支援 TDL / CDL、custom fading profile、Doppler、delay、path loss

key_points.point: Quantified SMW200A end-to-end emulation capability: up to 1073 ms delay and ±1 MHz Doppler
SMW200A component-test frequency and bandwidth capability
